lede: Mississippi State carries the stronger underlying team rating — +8.0 against +7.1, a 0.8-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Mississippi State -1.6 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Mississippi State winning 54% of simulations.
The position-group comparison shows where the separation comes from: the widest measured gap is linebackers, where Missouri leads Mississippi State by 79 places nationally.
Data confidence on this matchup is 79% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
